config.authorization: Owner selected entry research directions 2 and 3 on 2026-10-21; run separately, no live/default changes.
config.baseline: Frozen V2.31 five-year original signal and matched control ledger, without sweep or MTF filters.
config.stop: Exact touch candle extreme; no buffer. Preserve original first-match consumption and positive one-tick minimum risk.
config.exit: Existing Nautilus 15m2/2 first profitable pivot confirmed two bars later; market exit at confirmation close, initial stop has priority. No forced day/year exits. Strict-tie sensitivity retained.
config.controls: Preserve all original matched pair IDs and times, same symbol/side/UTC week/chronological half/ATR bucket. Apply the tested rule to each population, retain rejected/unfilled opportunities as zero. No redraw after outcomes.
config.analysis: Primary equal-entry-notional net bp per original opportunity, plus actual-risk R and original-risk R bridge; weekly paired sign randomization and block bootstrap; chronological halves and years; Holm adjustment. No parameter search.
config.entry: Original entries and executions unchanged; classify each signal/control at its own admission close using only completed1H candles. Two most recently confirmed2/2 high pivots and low pivots: HH+HL upward, LH+LL downward, all other combinations mixed; fewer than two highs or lows unknown. Relative to trade direction: aligned/counter/mixed/unknown. Each context evaluated separately.
config.ties: Default latest tie wins (center >= left, > right); strict > all four is a sensitivity only.
config.causality: No provisional pivots, backfill or future-hour visibility. Prefix invariance checked at actual entry closes. Mixed structure is not asserted to be a range.
